data.Anchor: Frame 0 already shows the product, a result or a bold line; by 1 s the viewer knows what this is and wants the next beat.
Strong opening image by 0.3 s and a clear promise by 1 s; one small hesitation.
Content by 0.5 s, purpose clear by 1.5 s.
Opens on a generic title or logo but moves to content within 1.5 s.
A title fading over brand colour; purpose clear only after 2 s.
Empty, black or logo-only opening longer than 1 s.
Nothing readable or nothing happening in the first 2 s.
Real brand material (logo, real screens, real copy voice) used with the brand's own palette roles and type; nothing generic.
Palette roles and type exact; real material present; one element feels borrowed from a template.
Correct colours and fonts; real material present but secondary.
Correct colours; generic shapes and stock-like layouts dominate.
Colours roughly right, type wrong, no real material.
Could be any brand.
Conflicts with the brand (wrong colours, misused logo).
Arrivals land with weight, exits are faster than entrances, overlaps are tuned, camera moves are motivated, nothing floats.
All of the above with one slightly generic ease or stagger.
Purposeful and varied; a few moves feel mechanical.
One ease and one timing used everywhere; competent but uniform.
Fade-and-slide on everything; idle loops or creeping scales.
Jittery, abrupt or random movement.
Motion that obstructs reading or looks broken.
Every line holds long enough, sized for the phone sheet, high contrast, never competing with another line.
One line slightly fast or small, still readable.
All readable; one or two need a second look.
Readable on desktop, strained on the phone sheet.
Some lines too fast, small or low-contrast to read once.
Several lines unreadable.
Most copy unreadable.
Something new on every beat, layout changes on the bar, holds only where meaning needs them, sound hits land on picture.
Same, with one beat that drags or rushes.
Even pacing; a few soft spots.
Pacing follows a grid mechanically; no variation in energy.
Noticeable dead stretches or crowded bursts.
Long still stretches; cuts unrelated to the beat.
No discernible rhythm.
Clean edges, consistent spacing and radii, no banding, no clipping, correct alpha edges, mixed loudness on target.
One minor craft flaw visible only on close inspection.
Two or three minor flaws.
A flaw visible at normal viewing (misalignment, banding, harsh shadow).
Several visible flaws.
Looks like a draft.
Broken output.
